notes: Complete global petrochemical, specialty intermediate, and oleochemical trade-flow KG (2025-2026 baseline). Includes port lat/lon coordinates, split Suez/Bab el-Mandeb chokepoints, Hormuz bypass ports, USGC ethane VLEC flows, Turkish soda ash, and full coverage of all INDIAN-EQUITIES watchlist substances.

geo:ae.label: United Arab Emirates
geo:ae.notes: Major Borouge polyolefins, ADNOC base oil/fertilizer/EDC/LAB producer (Ruwais), plus Jebel Ali/Fujairah re-export & bunkering hubs; Fujairah sits outside Hormuz.

geo:be.label: Belgium
geo:be.notes: Europe's largest integrated chemical cluster and import/re-export gateway (Antwerp-Rotterdam-Rhine pipeline hub); major VLEC ethane/ethylene receiving terminal.

geo:br.label: Brazil
geo:br.notes: Major South American deficit market for US/ME/Chinese PE, PP, PVC, caustic soda, methanol, urea, and Russian/US diesel & fertilizers.

geo:cn.label: China
geo:cn.notes: Dual coal-to-chemicals (CTO/MTO) and coastal mega-refinery powerhouse. Dominant net exporter of PP, PVC, styrene (~1 Mt/yr pace in 2026), TiO2, caustic soda, and specialty intermediates/amines/acids, while importing US ethane, specialty PE, PX, methanol, and palm oleochemicals. Abolished export VAT rebates across 249 products (incl. PVC, MEG, methanol) effective April 1, 2026.

geo:co.label: Colombia
geo:co.notes: Regional PVC/PP exporter in LatAm and emerging palm oil diversification supplier to India as SEA biodiesel mandates tighten CPO exports.

geo:de.label: Germany
geo:de.notes: Net importer of commodity base chemicals via ARA Rhine corridor amid domestic cracker closures, while remaining a major exporter of high-spec specialty intermediates, carboxylic acids, NPG, polyols, and alkoxylates.

geo:eg.label: Egypt
geo:eg.notes: Mediterranean exporter of urea, ammonia, methanol, and PVC/PE; bypasses Strait of Hormuz and Suez/Red Sea for European deliveries.

geo:id.label: Indonesia
geo:id.notes: World's largest palm oil, PKO, PFAD, fatty acid, and biodiesel producer; B40/B50 domestic mandates increasingly cap CPO export surplus while nickel/alumina refining pulls caustic soda imports.

geo:in.label: India
geo:in.notes: Primary INDIAN-EQUITIES target deficit market: structural imports across PVC (~3.1 Mt/yr), EDC, methanol, styrene, phenol/acetone, oxo-alcohols, acrylates, amides, amines, solvents, Group II/III base oils, US ethane, and palm oil; active trade defense (DGFT Notification 25/2026-27 S-PVC $766/MT CIF MIP + DGTR ADDs; Nov 2025 BIS QCO rescission on 14 polymers/intermediates).

geo:ir.label: Iran
geo:ir.notes: Sanctioned low-cost gas producer exporting methanol, urea, ammonia, and polymers predominantly toward China; exports severely curtailed during 2026 Hormuz conflict and blockade.

geo:jp.label: Japan
geo:jp.notes: Exporter of PVC, caustic soda, specialty polyolefins, VCM, MMA, ACN, cyclohexanone, adipic acid, and aromatics into India and SEA despite domestic cracker consolidation.

geo:kr.label: South Korea
geo:kr.notes: Major export hub (CEPA-advantaged into India) for aromatics (BTX, OX, MX, C9), Group II/III base oils, PE/PP, PVC, PIA, VAM, acrylates, PU polyols/isocyanates, phenol, and VPEG-2400.

geo:ma.label: Morocco
geo:ma.notes: Global anchor exporter of phosphoric acid and phosphate fertilizers (OCP), importing ammonia and sulphur/sulphuric acid.

geo:mx.label: Mexico
geo:mx.notes: Integrated by pipeline, rail, and short-sea tanker with USGC; imports PE, PP, VCM, methanol, caustic soda, and solvents.

geo:my.label: Malaysia
geo:my.notes: Global leader in downstream oleochemicals (fatty acids, fatty alcohols, glycerin, soap noodles, ethoxylates) plus Petronas/Pengerang & BASF-Petronas Kuantan (acrylics, oxo-alcohols, MEG, methanol, PE, PP).

geo:nl.label: Netherlands
geo:nl.notes: Primary European seaborne entry and distribution hub (ARA) for US/ME polymers, methanol, caustic soda, aromatics, biodiesel, Turkish soda ash, and Malaysian/Indonesian oleochemicals; exports Shell/Lyondell specialty diols, glycol ethers, and C9 solvents.

geo:om.label: Oman
geo:om.notes: Outside the Strait of Hormuz; critical resilient supplier of methanol, urea, ammonia, OQ Sohar oxo-alcohols (2-EH, NBA, IBA), OX/MX, and Liwa plastics (PE/PP) to India and Europe.

geo:pk.label: Pakistan
geo:pk.notes: Major importer of palm oil (from Indonesia/Malaysia), Chinese styrene/PVC/PP, MEG/PTA precursors, and industrial chemicals.

geo:qa.label: Qatar
geo:qa.notes: Low-cost gas exporter of PE, urea, ammonia, methanol, alpha-olefins, n-paraffins/LAB, melamine, and EDC; heavily exposed to 2026 Strait of Hormuz transit restrictions.

geo:ru.label: Russia
geo:ru.notes: Sanction-redirected exporter of urea, ammonia, methanol, diesel/fuel oil, and polyolefins toward China (via Nakhodka), India, Turkey, and Brazil.

geo:sa.label: Saudi Arabia
geo:sa.notes: Global anchor exporter (SABIC/Sadara/Sipchem/SATORP) of PE, PP, MEG, DEG, EDC, methanol, VAM, polyols, ethanolamines, MDI/TDI, urea, ammonia, and Group II/III base oils; Yanbu Red Sea port bypasses Hormuz.

geo:sg.label: Singapore
geo:sg.notes: Major integrated petrochemical producer (Jurong Island: ExxonMobil/Shell/Celanese/Evonik) and ASEAN liquid bulk/bunker blending & breakbulk distribution hub.

geo:th.label: Thailand
geo:th.notes: ASEAN petrochemical hub (Map Ta Phut) exporting PVC, PP, phenol, and aromatics while importing naphtha, ethylene/VCM, and facing Chinese polymer/styrene competition.

geo:tr.label: Turkey
geo:tr.notes: Dual-role market: major Mediterranean net importer of PP, PE, PVC, styrene, methanol, and caustic soda (from ME, China, Russia, US), AND top-2 global exporter of natural soda ash (>5 Mt/yr trona capacity via Eti Soda / Kazan Soda).

geo:tt.label: Trinidad and Tobago
geo:tt.notes: Atlantic Basin hub for merchant methanol and anhydrous ammonia exports to North America, Europe, and Brazil.

geo:tw.label: Taiwan
geo:tw.notes: Key exporter (Formosa, Dairen, Chang Chun, Shiny) of PVC, PP, VAM, oxo-alcohols, PIA, MAN, THF, phenol/acetone, and caustic soda to India, SEA, and US.

geo:us.label: United States
geo:us.notes: USGC shale-gas powerhouse exporting >55% of PE output, record >800 kb/d ethane, cryogenic ethylene monomer, PVC/VCM/EDC, caustic soda, methanol, ethanol, VAM, acetyls/oxo solvents, amines, and Group II base oils globally.

geo:vn.label: Vietnam
geo:vn.notes: Fast-growing ASEAN manufacturing sink importing PP, PE, PVC, MEG, solvents, TiO2, and polyurethane systems from China, Korea, Taiwan, Malaysia, and Middle East.

chokepoint:hormuz.label: Strait of Hormuz
chokepoint:hormuz.alt_route_name: Pipeline / Non-Hormuz Port Bypass (Yanbu, Fujairah, Sohar)
chokepoint:hormuz.notes: 2026 conflict severely curtailed Persian Gulf methanol (~35% global seaborne), urea (~33% global traded), MEG, EDC, ammonia, and polyolefin sailings; buyers pivoted to Oman, Saudi Yanbu, USGC, and China/APAC.

chokepoint:bab-el-mandeb.label: Bab el-Mandeb Strait (Southern Red Sea)
chokepoint:bab-el-mandeb.notes: Southern Red Sea chokepoint linking Asia/Indian Ocean to Suez and Yanbu; maritime threats force Asia-Europe and US-India vessels around Cape of Good Hope (+10-14 days, +3,500 nm).

chokepoint:suez-canal.label: Suez Canal
chokepoint:suez-canal.notes: Northern Red Sea / Mediterranean gateway; traversed by Yanbu-to-Europe sailings (without Bab el-Mandeb) and full Asia/Gulf-to-Europe/USGC voyages unless rerouted via Cape.

chokepoint:malacca.label: Strait of Malacca
chokepoint:malacca.notes: Primary artery connecting Middle East/India/Europe to Northeast Asia and Indonesian/Malaysian oleochemical hubs.

chokepoint:panama.label: Panama Canal
chokepoint:panama.notes: Key route for USGC ethane, ethylene, PE, MEG, and caustic soda moving to Northeast Asia and West Coast LatAm.

corridors.drivers_2025_2026: USGC ethane/gas cost advantage + EU cracker closures (37 Mt cumulative since 2022) + EU elimination of 6.5% tariff on US PE imports + USGC methanol & chlor-alkali surplus.
corridors.trade_barriers: Zero EU tariff on US PE (2025-2026); Rotterdam serves as ARA redistribution hub into geo:de and geo:be.

corridors.drivers_2025_2026: USGC VLEC ethane (~77 kb/d to Europe) and cryogenic ethylene exports feed Antwerp crackers/derivatives facing uncompetitive European naphtha economics.
USGC supplies Brazilian alumina/pulp caustic soda demand, PE/PVC pipe & packaging shortfalls, and Atlantic methanol/distillate balances.
USMCA integration; USGC supplies VCM feedstock to Mexican PVC plants and finished PE/PP resins.
VLEC ethane feeds Indian gas crackers (~53 kb/d); PE, PVC, and industrial ethanol expanded in 2026 as India diversified away from Hormuz-disrupted Gulf supply.
corridors.trade_barriers: PVC subject to Indian DGTR suspension ADD scrutiny and July 2026 S-PVC $766/MT CIF MIP.

corridors.drivers_2025_2026: USGC oxo/acetyl/amine producers (Dow, Eastman, Celanese, Olin) export surplus VAM, EDC, n-propanol, MP-diol, and carboxylic acids into India.
Record USGC VLEC ethane exports to Chinese coastal ethane crackers (~618 kb/d in Aug 2026 via Nederland & Morgan's Point), plus specialty metallocene PE.
Atlantic freight access supplies Turkish pipe/film converters and chemical users as Middle East Hormuz routes tighten.
Core ethane-advantaged export corridor into Chinese polyester (MEG) and converter demand; moderated by China's domestic capacity ramp and 2026 Hormuz disruptions.
Short-haul Arabian Sea corridor; Yanbu Red Sea terminal buffers Saudi shipments during Hormuz friction (though Yanbu-to-India transits Bab el-Mandeb).
Sadara/SABIC/Sipchem complexes export large volumes of EDC (for Indian PVC makers), DEG, polyols, ethanolamines, and VAM into West Coast India.
Fills European polymer and Group II/III base oil deficits; Jubail loads transit Hormuz+Bab el-Mandeb+Suez (or Cape), whereas Yanbu northbound bypasses both Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb via Suez.
Turkey is one of the largest net importers of Saudi polyolefins; Yanbu loadings reach Turkey via Suez only, insulating against Hormuz/Bab el-Mandeb.
Major nitrogen fertilizer & PE supplier to India; highly exposed to 2026 Hormuz outages with no bypass port.
Qatar supplies n-paraffins/LAB, alpha-olefins, and melamine into India; exposed to Hormuz transit risk.
Ethane-advantaged Qatari LDPE/LLDPE and methanol flows into East China; severely disrupted in 2026 Hormuz crisis.
Atlantic/South American urea supply via Cape of Good Hope; Hormuz shocks tighten Brazilian fertilizer stocks.
UAE-India CEPA supports polyolefin (Borouge) and Group III base oil (ADNOC) exports into India; Fujairah acts outside Hormuz for liquids.
UAE-India CEPA supports Ruwais aliphatic solvents, LAB/n-paraffins, and EDC flows into Gujarat/Maharashtra.
Borouge pipe/film PE and PP grades into South & East China converters.
Sohar & Salalah sit outside the Strait of Hormuz, making Oman a critical resilient supplier to India's west coast (Kandla/Dahej) during 2026 Gulf chokepoint stress.
OQ Chemicals Sohar oxo-alcohol and aromatics complex supplies 2-EH, NBA, IBA, and OX into India outside the Strait of Hormuz.
Historically ~10 Mt/yr sanction-discounted Iranian methanol fed Chinese coastal MTO plants; effectively halted/severely curtailed during 2026 Hormuz conflict & blockade.

China became India's top PVC source and captured >50% of its record 2026 styrene export surge (104.7 kt in June 2026 alone) as ME/Asian outages tightened supply. April 2026 cancellation of China's 13% PVC export tax rebate lifted FOB floors.
corridors.trade_barriers: India DGFT Notification 25/2026-27 S-PVC Minimum Import Price ($0.766/kg = $766/MT CIF, July 2026 - Jan 2027) and active DGTR ADD investigations on Chinese PVC, TiO2, and aniline.

corridors.drivers_2025_2026: China dominates Indian imports of specialty organic acids, amides (DMF/DMAC), melamine, PCE concrete macromonomer (VPEG-2400), pharma/agro intermediates, and chloromethanes.
corridors.trade_barriers: Active Indian DGTR ADDs on Chinese melamine, sodium gluconate, aniline, phthalic anhydride, and selected chloromethanes.

corridors.drivers_2025_2026: East China integrated oxo-alcohol, acrylate, alkylamine, and ester capacities feed Indian coatings, adhesive, and API solvent demand.
Vietnam is China's top ASEAN export sink for PP, styrenics, PVC, and coatings/construction chemicals.
Indonesian nickel/alumina refining absorbs large Chinese caustic soda volumes alongside surging Chinese PP exports.
China's 2026 PP and styrene export surge displaced regional naphtha-cracker margins in Thailand.
Waterbed outlet for Chinese PVC restricted by India MIP and 2026 top-2 destination for China's booming styrene exports.
Chinese PVC, PP, styrenics, and TiO2 divert to South America (typically via Cape of Good Hope) when US/India tariff barriers bind.
Top-3 destination for Chinese styrene exports in 2026 alongside PVC and PP converters.
Structural flip: China exported styrene back into South Korea in 2025-2026 as Chinese integrated capacity undercut Korean naphtha-based SM units.
Low-cost Chinese chloride/sulfate TiO2 and epoxy resins target EU coatings demand despite tariff headwinds.
corridors.trade_barriers: EU anti-dumping duties on Chinese TiO2 and epoxy resins (2025-2026).

corridors.drivers_2025_2026: Korea remains China's largest import origin for propylene copolymers and aromatics, though commodity PP volumes have shrunk sharply as China achieved self-sufficiency.
Korea-India CEPA preferential tariffs make Korea a top supplier of Group II/III base oils, phenol, solvents, and PVC into India.
Korea-India CEPA 0% preferential tariffs anchor Korean aromatics (OX, MX, C9), PIA, VAM, acrylates, PU polyols/isocyanates, and VPEG-2400 into India.
USGC ethane crackers produce minimal aromatics, creating structural US import pull for Korean benzene and Group III base oils.
India-Japan CEPA duty concessions make Japan a top-3 PVC supplier to India alongside China and Taiwan.
India-Japan CEPA supports high-purity Japanese monomers, cyclohexanone, adipic acid, and specialty ether acetates into India.
Formosa Plastics exports high-grade S-PVC, phenol/acetone, and epoxies into Indian pipes, laminates, and coatings converters.
Taiwan (Formosa, Dairen, Chang Chun, Shiny) supplies Indian coatings, UP resin, and pharmaceutical solvent shortages.
Jurong Island integrated complexes supply specialty PP/PE grades and aromatics into South & East China.
Jurong Island production plus Singapore breakbulk tank-terminal distribution supplying Indian coatings, pharma, and lube blenders.
Jurong Island ExxonMobil/Shell/Celanese/Evonik complexes + ASEAN AIFTA access make Singapore India's top hub for C9, glycol ethers/acetates, propanol, and VAM.
Indonesia supplies massive crude fatty acid and palm kernel oil volumes to Malaysian oleochemical splitters and refineries.
India is Indonesia's single largest export market for palm oil; tightening under Indonesia's B40/B50 biodiesel mandates in 2025-2026.
Major corridor for oleochemical feedstocks, stearic/oleic fatty acids, fatty alcohols (for SLES/surfactants), and glycerin into China.
Netherlands (Rotterdam) is Malaysia's #1 export destination for industrial fatty acids and fatty alcohols, aided by EU ADDs on Indonesian fatty acids.
corridors.trade_barriers: Subject to EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) compliance and EU sustainability rules on palm biodiesel.

corridors.drivers_2025_2026: China is Malaysia's #2 destination for industrial fatty acids and alcohols plus soap noodles and refined glycerin.
Petronas / Pengerang (PRefChem) MEG, methanol, and polyolefins feeding South/East China.
Intra-ASEAN AFTA zero-duty flows from Malaysian petrochemicals and oleochemical plants into southern Vietnam.
Malaysia gained palm, oleochemical, and methanol share into India in 2026 as Indonesian B50 absorbed domestic CPO and Hormuz tightened Gulf methanol.
BASF-Petronas Kuantan + Pengerang complexes supply India with acrylic acid/acrylates, oxo-alcohols, and fatty alcohol ethoxylates under AIFTA.
Pakistan is a top-tier Indonesian palm oil export market for edible oil and soap-making.
Emerging 2026 diversification corridor initiated by Indian refiners as Indonesia/Malaysia raise biodiesel mandates.
Point Lisas remains a key Atlantic supplier of anhydrous ammonia to US agricultural and industrial buyers, though US methanol capacity has reduced US methanol imports.
Supplies European methanol (formaldehyde/acetic acid/biodiesel) and ammonia deficits into Rotterdam.
Short Mediterranean haul avoids Suez/Hormuz bottlenecks; competes under EU CBAM rules for fertilizers.
corridors.trade_barriers: Subject to EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) financial pricing on fertilizers/ammonia from Jan 2026.

corridors.drivers_2025_2026: Low-cost natural trona soda ash (Eti Soda / Kazan Soda, >5 Mt/yr capacity) displaces high-energy synthetic Solvay plants across Europe.
Turkish natural dense/light soda ash supplies Indian float glass and detergent manufacturers.
Morocco (OCP) is India's anchor supplier of merchant-grade phosphoric acid for DAP/NPK fertilizer manufacturing.
Post-2022 sanctions rerouted Russian Baltic/Black Sea urea and ULSD heavily into Brazil's agribusiness sector.
Black Sea proximity and European sanctions made Turkey a top sink for Russian methanol, Siberian polymers, and distillates.
Russian Far East & Siberian (Sibur/Nakhodka) flows into China via rail and short-sea Japan Sea route; gained share during 2026 Hormuz disruptions.
Russia supplies discounted crude/distillates and urea into India, increasingly vital when Persian Gulf urea is trapped by Hormuz.
Rotterdam-Rhine corridor feeds German inland chemical complexes (Ludwigshafen, Marl, Wesseling) as domestic European capacity shuts down.
European specialty producers (BASF, Evonik, OQ, Lanxess) ship high-purity carboxylic acids, NPG, isophorone, polyols, and alkoxylates into Indian pharma/coatings/PU.
ARA chemical cluster exports Shell/LyondellBasell specialty diols, glycol ethers, and C9 aromatic solvents to India.
